content:
This month, Apple will unveil its first foldable iPhone — reportedly to be named the iPhone Ultra. The device is said to feature a 5.5-inch outer display and a 7.6-inch inner display. Samsung already launched the new Galaxy Z Fold 8 back in July, which uses exactly the same screen sizes.

Whether Samsung deliberately released this phone ahead of the iPhone Ultra is another matter — but either way, the Galaxy Z Fold 8 has given us a rough idea of what the iPhone Ultra will actually be like to use.

Reviewers who got early hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 have recently been posting comparison photos on Twitter. Since the iPhone Ultra and Galaxy Z Fold 8 are similar in size, these comparisons give us an early preview of how the iPhone Ultra will look and feel in real-world scenarios.

Ray Wong published several comparison shots of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 alongside the previous-generation iPad mini, highlighting how this phone truly puts an iPad mini-sized screen in your pocket — with even narrower bezels.

Meanwhile, enthusiast Shishir shared comparison photos of the iPhone 13 mini with the Galaxy Z Fold 8. The iPhone 13 mini is slightly taller than this foldable, but both are equally compact. For users who love the iPhone mini lineup, the iPhone Ultra might just bring back that feeling.

Personally, after getting hands-on time with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 last week, I'm actually more excited about the iPhone Ultra. The two are nearly identical in size (though the iPhone Ultra is reportedly going with rounded corners) — so before its official debut in September, this is the best preview we have of what Apple has up its sleeve.

Of course, you can also check out dummy unit photos for further comparison.
